prompt: I need to add the BIR Deadline Watcher feature. Scaffold the whole thing: Supabase migration for the bir_deadlines table with RLS, the API route at /api/deadlines that returns upcoming deadlines for the user, and the page at /app/(app)/(features)/deadlines/ with a DeadlineCard component that shows the form type, due date, days remaining, and a filed/unfiled status badge. The card should turn amber when 7 days away and red when 3 days or less. Everything mobile-first.

assertions.text: Migration SQL enables RLS on bir_deadlines table
RLS policies scope to auth.uid() = user_id
Table includes deleted_at column and soft-delete pattern
API route includes auth check and user-scoped query
DeadlineCard uses conditional color: amber/honey for 7-day warning, red for 3-day urgent
Page is a Server Component, DeadlineCard is appropriately split (client if interactive)
Mobile-first responsive design (base styles for mobile, sm:/md: for larger)
